rawRecord.EXPERIMENTAL_ai_generated_description: The Rapid7 Bulk Export MCP server exports vulnerability and asset data from the Rapid7 Command Platform via the Bulk Export API and makes it queryable in AI and agentic workflows. Six tools support natural language queries, SQL execution against exported datasets, schema exploration, and statistical analysis. Compatible with Claude Desktop, GitHub Copilot, and Kiro.
